migrations.risk: Four nullable columns are added to existing personal provider connection rows without rewriting ciphertext, identity, status, current generation, storage selection or existing provider facts. Existing revoked rows retain an unknown provider outcome; neither revoked status nor a missing error proves Google accepted revocation. New requests persist the exact generation and remain unconfirmed until an explicit provider result is recorded. The migration is reserved after J13's separate 0037 and cannot be remotely applied from this standalone branch.
migrations.rollbackPlan: Keep Drive UI and workers disabled. Do not drop requested, in-flight or confirmed evidence after runtime use. Reconcile the exact actor-owned generation and provider outcome before any separately reviewed schema rollback; never revoke an active same-account generation from an undifferentiated historical row.
postconditions: four nullable request, confirmation and attempt columns exist on provider_connections
all preexisting credential and storage rows retain their original values and identities
legacy revoked rows do not gain inferred request or confirmation timestamps
integrity and foreign key checks pass
